harness_env:
# Locked harness settings shared by every eval runner (sourced by scripts/eval_common.sh).
# Single source of truth: every model (base / e_* / mixed / merged_*) is evaluated with these
# exact values. A copy is written into every run directory (run_meta.json). Do not edit
# between runs; any change = new protocol version (bump HARNESS_VERSION and re-run Base).
HARNESS_VERSION=1

# ---------- serving (slurm/serve_model.sbatch) ----------
SERVED_MODEL_NAME=qwen3.6-35b-a3b              # Harbor hosted_vllm/ rejects names with '/'
BASE_MODEL_DIR=/scratch/eh3323/apex/models/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
MAX_MODEL_LEN=262144                           # 256K context (TB2 spec), same for all benchmarks
# tokenizer, chat template and generation_config are ALWAYS taken from BASE_MODEL_DIR,
# so experts/merged differ only in weights.
DEFAULT_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS='{"enable_thinking": true, "preserve_thinking": false}'
# server-side default for requests that send no max_tokens (mini-swe-agent, opencode):
OVERRIDE_GENERATION_CONFIG='{"max_new_tokens": 81920}'

# ---------- sampling (Qwen3.6 model card, thinking mode) ----------
TEMPERATURE=1.0
TOP_P=0.95
TOP_K=20
MAX_TOKENS=81920
HLE_PRESENCE_PENALTY=1.5                       # HLE only (spec); agent harnesses send none

# ---------- TB2 ----------
TB2_DIR=/scratch/eh3323/apex/data/benchmarks/terminal_bench2_repo   # @2fd12b88, 89 tasks
TB2_AGENT=terminus-2
TB2_TIMEOUT_SEC=10800
# Terminus-2 context budget (model_info.max_input_tokens): prompt + max_tokens must fit the 256K window,
# so proactive summarization triggers at 262144-81920; DECISION ITEM (alt: 262144 = rely on reactive unwind)
TB2_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=180224
TB2_CPUS=32
TB2_MEMORY_MB=49152
TB2_K_DEFAULT=5
TB2_SMOKE_TASKS="fix-git nginx-request-logging"

# ---------- SWE-bench Pro HARD-51 ----------
SWE_REPO=/scratch/eh3323/apex/data/benchmarks/swebench_pro_repo     # @66f9276
SWE_TASKS=$SWE_REPO/v2/tasks
SWE_IDS=$SWE_REPO/v2/hard51_ids.txt
SWE_CONFIG=$SWE_REPO/v2/tooling/configs/mini_toolcall.yaml
SWE_STEP_LIMIT=250
SWE_BUDGET_SEC=3000                            # 50 min (task.toml agent timeout); soft stop 60 s earlier
SWE_SMOKE_N=2

# ---------- ASI-Bench ----------
ASI_REPO=/scratch/eh3323/apex/data/benchmarks/asibench_repo         # @8859f9b
ASI_FULL=/scratch/eh3323/apex/data/benchmarks/asibench_seed31415    # contains reference/ -> hidden from agents
ASI_NOREF=/scratch/eh3323/apex/work/asi_instances_noref                # agent-visible copy: no reference/, no solver.py, instance_meta reduced to params_used
ASI_AGENT=opencode_cli
ASI_TIMEOUT_SEC=10800
ASI_LEVELS_DEFAULT=b1,b2,b3,b4
ASI_SMOKE_TASKS=astronomy.nbody_close_encounters,math.nnls_modulus_deblur   # 1 deterministic + 1 judge task
OPENCODE_VERSION=1.17.15

# ---------- HLE ----------
HLE_DATASET=/scratch/eh3323/apex/data/benchmarks/hle                # cais/hle @5a81a4c7, 2500 q
HLE_JUDGE=o3-mini-2025-01-31
HLE_WORKERS=256
HLE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SEC=7200
HLE_SMOKE_N=5
